description: Risk patterns derived from the OWASP mapping. Each pattern links a discovered functionality to known risks.

risks.title: Broken Authentication
risks.description: Authentication mechanisms may be bypassed, brute-forced, or abused.

risks.title: Credential Stuffing
risks.description: Login endpoints may be vulnerable to automated credential-stuffing attacks.

risks.title: Weak Password Policy
risks.description: Registration or password-reset flows may not enforce adequate password strength.

risks.title: User Enumeration
risks.description: Authentication responses may reveal whether a username or email exists.

risks.title: Password Reset Abuse
risks.description: Password-reset flows may be abused to take over accounts.

risks.title: Session Fixation
risks.description: Session identifiers may not be rotated after authentication.

risks.title: Broken Access Control
risks.description: Admin panels may be accessible without proper authorization.

risks.title: Sensitive Data Exposure
risks.description: Administrative endpoints may expose sensitive user or system data.

risks.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
risks.description: Admin CRUD operations may allow access to objects belonging to other users.

risks.title: Broken Access Control
risks.description: Dashboards may expose data or actions to unauthorized users.

risks.title: Information Disclosure
risks.description: Dashboards may leak internal identifiers, stack traces, or business metrics.

risks.title: SQL Injection
risks.description: Search parameters may be passed unsanitized to database queries.

risks.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
risks.description: Search results may reflect user input without proper encoding.

risks.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
risks.description: Search functionality may fetch or proxy resources from attacker-supplied URLs.

risks.title: Mass Assignment
risks.description: API endpoints may accept client-controlled object properties.

risks.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
risks.description: Object identifiers in URLs may allow access to other users' records.

risks.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery
risks.description: State-changing forms may lack anti-CSRF tokens.

risks.title: Unrestricted File Upload
risks.description: File uploads may accept dangerous file types leading to remote code execution.

risks.title: Path Traversal
risks.description: Uploaded file paths may be controlled by the attacker.

risks.title: Path Traversal
risks.description: Download endpoints may allow reading arbitrary files.

risks.title: Sensitive Data Exposure
risks.description: Generated or exported files may contain sensitive data without access control.

risks.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
risks.description: API endpoints may not enforce authorization for each object.

risks.title: Broken Authentication
risks.description: API endpoints may lack authentication or rely on weak tokens.

risks.title: Excessive Data Exposure
risks.description: API responses may expose more data than intended.

risks.title: Mass Assignment
risks.description: API endpoints may accept unexpected properties.

risks.title: GraphQL Introspection Abuse
risks.description: Introspection may leak the full schema to unauthenticated users.

risks.title: GraphQL Query Depth / Complexity Attacks
risks.description: Deep or recursive queries may cause denial of service.

risks.title: GraphQL Authorization Bypass
risks.description: Resolvers may not enforce field- or object-level authorization.

risks.title: Security Through Obscurity
risks.description: Hidden or debug endpoints may be reachable without authentication.

risks.title: Information Disclosure
risks.description: Debug or internal routes may expose stack traces, configs, or routes.

risks.title: Payment Manipulation
risks.description: Checkout or payment endpoints may allow tampering with amounts, currencies, or recipient accounts.

risks.title: Insecure Card Data Handling
risks.description: Cardholder data may be logged, cached, or transmitted without adequate encryption.

risks.title: PCI-DSS Misconfiguration
risks.description: Payment pages may not meet PCI-DSS hardening requirements, increasing cardholder data exposure.

risks.title: OAuth Misconfiguration
risks.description: OAuth flows may accept wildcard redirect URIs or weak state parameters, enabling account takeover.

risks.title: Open Redirect via OAuth
risks.description: Authorization endpoints may redirect to attacker-controlled URLs, enabling phishing and token theft.

risks.title: Token Leakage in URL
risks.description: Authorization codes or access tokens may be passed in URL fragments or query strings and leak through logs/referrers.

risks.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
risks.description: Profile endpoints may expose or allow editing of other users' personal data by changing identifiers.

risks.title: PII Exposure
risks.description: Profile pages may expose personally identifiable information without proper access control.

risks.title: Account Takeover via Profile Update
risks.description: Profile update forms may allow changing email or password without re-authentication, enabling takeover.

risks.title: Privilege Escalation via Settings
risks.description: Settings endpoints may allow users to modify roles, permissions, or security-sensitive configuration.

risks.title: Insecure Default Configuration
risks.description: Default settings may leave debugging, weak passwords, or public features enabled in production.

risks.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
risks.description: User-submitted comments or reviews may be rendered without output encoding, enabling stored XSS.

risks.title: Content Injection / Spam
risks.description: Comment functionality may allow injection of malicious links or content without moderation.

risks.title: Email Header Injection
risks.description: Contact forms may allow SMTP header injection, enabling spam or phishing from the server.

risks.title: Information Disclosure
risks.description: Support or contact pages may leak internal email addresses, ticket IDs, or system details.

risks.title: Email Enumeration
risks.description: Newsletter subscribe responses may reveal whether an email address is already registered.

risks.title: Subscription Abuse
risks.description: Subscription forms may lack rate limiting, allowing mass sign-ups or harassment.

risks.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
risks.description: Webhook endpoints may fetch attacker-supplied URLs, exposing internal services.

risks.title: Webhook Secret Leakage
risks.description: Webhook signing secrets may be exposed in client-side code or logs.

risks.title: Replay Attack
risks.description: Webhook payloads may lack timestamp or nonce validation, allowing replay of old events.

risks.title: Sensitive Data Export
risks.description: Reporting endpoints may export sensitive data without adequate access control or auditing.

risks.title: Information Disclosure
risks.description: Reports may expose internal identifiers, revenue figures, or user activity.

risks.title: Unauthenticated Metrics Exposure
risks.description: Health, metrics, or status pages may leak system internals without authentication.

risks.title: Information Disclosure
risks.description: Monitoring endpoints may reveal version numbers, dependency details, or internal routes.

risks.title: Sensitive Endpoint Disclosure
risks.description: Documentation may reveal internal endpoints, API keys, or implementation details useful to attackers.

risks.title: API Key Exposure in Examples
risks.description: Documentation examples may include hardcoded credentials or valid API keys.
